name: ggwithinstats-edge_within_large_n-bayes

within_data.subject_order: sorted by subject as complete_subjects() sorts (numbers numerically, text in the C locale); the analysis holds the rows subject by subject, levels in order

messages:
Multiple `BFBayesFactor` models detected - posteriors are extracted from
  the first numerator model.

subtitle: list(log[e] * (BF["01"]) == "-0.74", widehat(italic(R^"2"))["Bayesian"]^"posterior" == "0.86", CI["95%"]^HDI ~ "[" * "0.85", "0.86" * "]", italic("r")["Cauchy"]^"JZS" == "0.71")
